'''''T-6'' 1974''',<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|ahsoka-s-t-6-jedi-shuttle|Ahsoka's T-6 Jedi Shuttle}}</ref> also known as '''''T-6'' One-Nine-Seven-Four''',<ref name="Part One">{{Ahsoka|Part One: Master and Apprentice}}</ref> was a [[T-6 shuttle]] used by [[Ahsoka Tano]] after the [[Galactic Civil War]] when she traveled to the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] to pick up [[Sabine Wren]] and begin their [[Quest to find Ezra Bridger|search]] for [[Ezra Bridger]].<ref name="Family&Farewell" />

==Characteristics==
Manufactured by the [[Verpine]] hives of [[Slayn & Korpil]], the nimble [[starship]] featured a rotating engine block and [[cockpit]], allowing the [[shuttle]] to land on varying planetary surfaces with flexibility. A single pilot could operate the shuttle, but Tano had the [[droid]] [[Huyang]] at her side as a navigator and copilot. Huyang used one area of the T-6's capacious interior as his workshop, where he stored his inventory of [[lightsaber]] components accumulated across his decades of teaching and overseeing lightsaber construction. Tano designated another area of the shuttle to lightsaber training, which she kept stocked with practice [[Bokken saber]]s and helmets.<ref name="SWECG" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars]], T-6 shuttles were a sign assistance was on the way. Years later, the T-6's recognizable silhouette still symbolized hope.<ref name="SWECG" /> Sometime after the [[Battle of Jakku]], and having reacquainted herself with lightsaber expert Huyang, Tano used this ship to travel to the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] to pick up [[Sabine Wren]] and begin their [[Quest to find Ezra Bridger|search]] for [[Ezra Bridger]].<ref name="Family&Farewell" /> Huyang and Tano landed the shuttle in the mouth of a [[Purrgil]]. Once inside the creature's mouth, the Purrgil jumped to [[hyperspace]],<ref name="Part Five">{{Ahsoka|Part Five: Shadow Warrior}}</ref> following an ancient migration from [[The galaxy|one galaxy]] to [[Far galaxy|another]], eventually arriving at the planet [[Peridea]].<ref name="Part Six">{{Ahsoka|Part Six: Far, Far Away}}</ref> On Peridea, the T-6 shuttle engaged in a number of attacks, revealing its resilience that once served it during the Clone Wars.<ref name="SWECG" />
